tests.name: network_guard
argv:
import socket
try: socket.create_connection(('example.com',443)); raise AssertionError('network allowed')
except RuntimeError as e: assert str(e)=='OFFLINE_TEST_NETWORK_DENIED'
print('NETWORK_DENIED')
